ownerStatement: Air Chorus 0.1.3: the same sound in fewer DSP instructions let's finish this and publish this for everyone. [On the hardware check:] Trial now, you can listen via usb. [Then:] the mod should go live with chris johnson credited, and should also tag him on github
reason: Owner-requested public release of the bit-identical efficiency pass, ending the beta pause. Three rolled-back RAM trials of this exact package (1307d719…) on the owner's MKII, read over its USB audio on 17 November 2026: four instances (two per core, on T1/T3/T5/T7 and on T3/T4/T7/T8) placed and ran; T3, T4 and T7 output exact digital zero for silent input at full settings; music on T3 with moving controls showed no spike above the stock take's; two instances per core add about 14% less DSP load than 0.1.2 did. Chip cycle timing remains unmeasured, and Part/project save and reload with Air Chorus saved, reboot persistence and eight instances on the unit were not tested.
